transcript: 2026 marketing predictions. Analog versus digital. Analog is going to be digital. And I know that sounds insane because everyone is talking about AI, everyone is talking about automation, everyone is talking about more ads, more funnels, more emails, and more content. But here's the pattern. Disrupt. When everything becomes digital, the thing that feels physical becomes premium. And when every brand is using A I, the brand that feels human stands out. When every company is sending automated emails, the handwritten note gets remembered. And when every product launch happens online, the in person event feels magical. And when every ad looks polished, the raw founder content behind the scene wins. That is why analog marketing is coming back. Not because digital is dead, but because digital is still the engine. But analog is because coming the trust layer. Physical mail, founder letters, printed inserts, VIP events, retail activations, pop UPS, community meet UPS, product packaging, customer gifts, behind the scenes content, real world moments that people actually remember. The brands that went in 2026 are not going to be the ones choosing analog or digital. They're going to be the ones combining both. Digital creates the reach, analog creates the relationship, digital gets the click, analog creates the memory. Digital scales attention. And analog builds trust. Trust. That is the shift. The brands relying on only one or the other are going to feel more and more replaceable. the brands that add real world experiences into the Customer journey are going to feel impossible to copy. So my prediction for 2026 is simple. The next wave of marketing is not more digital. It is digital distribution with analog trust. Let me know in the comments what you think.
